title: MCM Chromatin Flow Cytometry for Cell Cycle
author: Jacob Matson
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.bba8iihw
materials: Keep cells cold/on ice while extracting.
Prepare labeling reaction solutions during prior centrifugation.

steps.title: Prepare Cells
steps.instruction: Prepare ~60-80% confluent 6cm plates (plate ~300K cells the day before harvest to reach ~500-600K at collection).

steps.title: EdU Labeling (Optional)
steps.instruction: If EdU labeling is desired, perform this before antibody staining and before harvesting.

substeps.instruction: Label cells with EdU at a final concentration of 10 uM in media (add dropwise or via media exchange).
Incubate for 30 minutes.
Pellet cells at 2000g for 7 minutes.

steps.title: Cell Harvest and Initial Wash
steps.instruction: Harvest cells and wash to remove media.

substeps.instruction: Trypsinize cells into a single cell suspension; stop trypsinization by adding media with FBS.
Pipette up and down well to break up cell clumps.
Collect into 1.7mL eppendorfs if possible.
Aspirate gently, resuspend with 500uL cold PBS, and centrifuge at 2000g for 3 minutes.

steps.title: Chromatin Extraction or Whole Cell Prep
steps.instruction: Depending on the target, either extract chromatin or prepare for whole cell staining.

substeps.instruction: For chromatin flow: Aspirate gently and resuspend thoroughly with 500uL cold CSK (10mM Pipes pH 7.0, 100mM NaCl, 3mM MgCl2) + 0.5% Triton X-100 + protease/phosphatase inhibitors. For detection of associated vs loaded proteins, use 300mM NaCl in the CSK instead of 100mM. Incubate on ice for 5-10 minutes.
For whole cell staining (e.g., CDT1): Skip to fixation (Step 6), then permeabilize in 1 mL 0.5% triton-100 in PBS for 15 min at RT, mix well by pipette, and proceed to storage.
Add 1mL 1% BSA + PBS directly to the sample and gently pipette to mix.

steps.title: Cell Fixation
steps.instruction: Fix the cells to preserve structure.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate gently and resuspend cells very thoroughly in 500uL PBS + 4% paraformaldehyde.
Incubate at RT for 15 minutes.

steps.title: Post-Fixation Wash and Storage
steps.instruction: Wash and store cells if not proceeding immediately to staining.

substeps.instruction: Add 1mL 1% BSA + PBS directly to the sample and gently pipette to mix.
Centrifuge at 2000g for 7 minutes.
Aspirate gently (pipette recommended over vacuum) and resuspend with 1mL 1% BSA + PBS.
Store at 4 °C in 1% BSA, PBS for 1-2 weeks if needed.

steps.title: EdU Click Reaction (If Applicable)
steps.instruction: Perform the click reaction to label EdU-incorporated cells.

substeps.instruction: Prepare 500 mM ascorbic acid in water (0.88g per 10 ml water), vortex, and prepare fresh.

Prepare labeling reaction master mix per reaction: 5 uL CuSO4 (100 mM stock, 1 mM final), ~0.5 uL Alexa Fluor 647/488 Azide (1 mM stock, 0.2–2 uM final), and 100 uL Ascorbic acid (500 mM stock, 100 mM final). Add ascorbic acid last.
Resuspend cell pellet in 500 uL labeling reaction solution.
Incubate at RT for 30 minutes, protected from light.
Add 1ml of PBS + 1% BSA + 0.1% NP-40.

steps.title: Primary Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Stain cells with the appropriate primary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate gently, removing liquid down to ~5uL or less using a pipette.

Resuspend cells in 50uL of 1% BSA + PBS + 0.1% NP-40 containing primary antibody diluted 1:200 (anti MCM2 BM28, antiMCM3, RPA2 ab2175, or yH2AX Rb CST 9718S) or 1:100 (whole cell CDT1 ab202067 Rb). For negative controls, omit the primary antibody.
Incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour in the dark.
Add 1mL 1% BSA + PBS + 0.1% NP-40 and gently pipette to mix.

steps.title: Secondary Antibody Staining
steps.instruction: Stain cells with a fluorescent secondary antibody.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate gently, removing liquid down to ~5uL or less using a pipette.
Resuspend cells in 200uL of 1% BSA + PBS + 0.1% NP-40 containing secondary antibody at 1:1000 (e.g., DantiM-488 for BM28).
Incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour in the dark.
Add 1mL 1% BSA + PBS + 0.1% NP-40 and gently pipette to mix.

steps.title: DNA Staining and Analysis
steps.instruction: Stain DNA and prepare for flow cytometry.

substeps.instruction: Aspirate gently and resuspend cells in 500uL 1% BSA + PBS + 0.1% NP-40 containing 1 ug/mL DAPI and 100 ug/mL RNAase.
Incubate in the fridge overnight in the dark, or incubate at 37 °C for 1 hour.
Run on flow cytometer.
